notes.title: [Event] #Sound4Champs: Win Gaming Headsets (Nov 25th - Dec 1st)
notes.content:
[h1]Update Dec-06[/h1]
Check out the lucky winners and their contributions in our new [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/374520/announcements/detail/275113954143268484]announcement[/url].

[code]Former news post:[/code]

Dear Community Champions!

Champions of Anteria has been nominated by "Deutscher Entwicklerpreis 2016"
(German Developer Award) for [b]Best Sound[/b]. Talking about awesome sound: 
Join our event and win 1 of 3 brand new gaming headsets!

[h1][B]Important Event Details[/b][/h1]
[LIST]
[*] [B]When[/B]: November 25th to December 1st, 2016
[*] [B]Task[/B]: Show your funniest/best screenshot of the game
[*] [B]On Steam[/B]: Simply use the screenshot (F12) and upload function of Steam
[*] [B]Forum/Facebook[/B]: Alternatively you can also join the event on the official forums or on Facebook. In that case, please check the details on the [url=ubi.li/z4vx6]official forums[/url].
[*] [B]Prizes[/B]: 3 ROCCAT CROSS headsets are waiting for the lucky winners
[*] [B]Lucky Draw[/B]: The winners of the prizes will be drawn until December 6th out of all participants of the event (Steam, forums, Facebook).
[/LIST]

[IMG]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/events/2016_11_25_event_en.jpg[/IMG]




[h1][B]Additional Notes & Conditions[/B][/h1]
[LIST]
[*] You need to own the full version of Champions of Anteria
[*] You have to be at least 18 years old, or need the permission of your parents.
[*] After the 3 winners have been drawn, we will inform you here on Steam via news post.

[*] [B]Getting in contact in case of Steam participation[/B]
If a Steam user was drawn, he will get a friend request from [URL]http://steamcommunity.com/id/BB_Graubart[/URL], who is a Steamworks Developer. Details about the shipping will be discussed then privately.

[*][b]Feedback/Confirmation (Steam)[/b]
A drawn Steam participant has time until December 20th to accept the friend request mentioned above and to get back to us in order to claim the  prize.

[*][B]Required Info[/B] 
We will only need a few details from the winners: The postal adress to ship the prize. The postal adress will [u]only[/u] be used for shipping.

[*][B]Winners announcement[/B] 
Once the winners have been drawn and confirmed, we will publish their images and ingame names (not the real names).[/LIST]

[Code]By joining the competition here on Steam you agree to the rules, especially the way of contact. Please refer to the event [url=ubi.li/z4vx6]details on the forums[/url] in case you want to join this event via forum or Facebook post.[/Code]


Good luck to all participants!
Your CoA Team

notes.title: The Beastmaster Free Update
notes.content:
[img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/2016_10_25_freedlc_en.jpg[/img]

The Beastmaster Free Update is available for everyone who owns Champions of Anteria! 
Meet a new Champion and use the mighty abilties of Tarn, the Beastmaster.


[h1]Release Trailer[/h1]
http://youtu.be/UI7cawxi1bQ


[h1]A New Champion: Tarn, the Beastmaster[/h1]

Tarn is a powerful dual axe wielding character that uses the momentum of the battle to fuel his rage. He can use his accumulated rage to either boost his damage or use it to deliver powerful blows to his enemies.

[URL=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/05b_champview_en.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/05b_champview_en_t.jpg[/img][/URL]

But first of all, you have to recruit him by conquering a special territory in the north. If you already occupied it, he will join your party instantly.

[URL=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/01b_map_en.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/01b_map_en_t.jpg[/img][/URL]

In the tavern you have now 7 Champions, if you have unlocked all of them.

[URL=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/07b_tavern_en.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/07b_tavern_en_t.jpg[/img][/URL]

The Beastmaster, ready for battle on the deployment screen.

[URL=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/06b_deployment_en.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/06b_deployment_en_t.jpg[/img][/URL]


[h1]Tarns' abilities in detail[/h1]

The Beastmaster has an impressive set of abilities you surely don't want to miss on the battlefield!

[URL=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/08b_abilities_en.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/08b_abilities_en_t.jpg[/img][/URL]


[h1]The Beastmaster in action[/h1]

See for yourself what The Beastmaster is capable of!

[URL=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/09b_action1.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/09b_action1_t.jpg[/img][/URL]

[URL=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/09b_action2.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/09b_action2_t.jpg[/img][/URL]

[URL=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/09b_action3.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/09b_action3_t.jpg[/img][/URL]

[URL=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/09b_action4.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/09b_action4_t.jpg[/img][/URL]


Get the free content update now and 
make Tarn the Beastmaster join your party to bring freedom to Anteria!

notes.title: The Alchemist Free Update
notes.content:
[img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/2016_10_17_freedlc_en.jpg[/img]

The Alchemist free update is available today. It delivers the first new Champion “Weissle (The Alchemist)” who will be unlocked by conquering a certain territory on the world map. Through her Special Resource called “Reagent” she is able to use the elements water, fire and lightning which she can even combine for the most devastating attacks.

Additionally, you will receive a blueprint to the new building “Foundry of Affinities” which once built will grant access to 5 hybrid potion recipes. Through the power of these potions you will be able to crush your enemies on their path to freeing Anteria from evil.



[h1]Release trailer[/h1]
https://youtu.be/5eDDB4hUkLI


[h1]New Champion: Weissle “The Alchemist”[/h1]
Weissle is a versatile character that uses quick fire “Catalyst” abilities that empower her with different reagents. She can then unleash the reagents she has gathered using powerful “Concoctions” that have varying effects based on the reagents that were used.

[url=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/05_champview_en.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/05_champview_en_t.jpg[/img][/url]

But first of all, you have to recruit her. Here is a little hint where to find her. Also note the new Champion UI!

[url=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/01_map_en.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/01_map_en_t.jpg[/img][/url]

After a good fight, Weissle likes to meet and catch up with the other Champions.

[url=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/07_tavern_en.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/steam/devdiary/07_tavern_en_t.jpg[/img][/url]



[h1]New Village Building: The Foundry of Affinities[/h1]
The building is unlocked from the village skill tree as normal and requires a “Basic” building slot within your village.

[url=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/forums/devdiary/03_building.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/forums/devdiary/03_building_t.jpg[/img][/url]



[h1]A new type of Potion - 5 new Hybrid Potions[/h1]
The “Foundry of Affinities” is a special building that once built unlocks 5 new hybrid potion recipes you can craft in your apothecary.

[url=http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/forums/devdiary/04_potions_en.jpg][img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/forums/devdiary/04_potions_en_t.jpg[/img][/url]



Extend your party of brave heroes and enjoy the new free DLC available for all Champions of Anteria players!

notes.title: Patch Notes (October 17th)
notes.content:
Dear Monster Thrashers,

on October 17th (approx at 6 pm CEST // 9 am PDT) a free DLC will expand your game. There are a few new features, the new Champion Weissle and optimisations and improvements. The following patchnotes sum everything up:

[IMG]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/forums/headers_banners/banner_patchnotes_en.png[/IMG]

[h1]New Champion: Weissle, The Alchemist[/h1]

[B]Abilities[/B]
Weissle is a versatile character that uses quick fire “Catalyst” abilities that empower her with different reagents. She can then unleash the reagents she has gathered using powerful “Concoctions” that have varying effects based on the reagents that were used. 

[B]Unlocking[/B]
The Alchemist can be unlocked by conquering a territory in the desert region of Anteria. If a player loads a save game and already owns that territory, he will have Weissle already unlocked.

[h1]New village building: The Foundry of Affinities[/h1]

[B]5 new potions[/B]
The “Foundry of Affinities” is a special building that once built unlocks 5 new hybrid potion recipes you can craft in your apothecary. 

[B]Unlocking[/B]
The building is unlocked from the village skill tree as normal and requires a “Basic” building slot within your village.

[h1]Missions[/h1]

[B]Improved AI pathfinding in narrow corridors.[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Allies will now wait and not run around the map to reach an unreachable enemy. 
[*]Enemies will now attack a different target within range if they can’t reach their highest agro target.[/LIST]

[B]Action queue[/B]
Fixed an issue with champions losing their action queue when being blocked by another unit.

[B]Unit movement speed[/B]
Fixed an issue that made the Dark Cult assassination target move very fast when attacking.

[B]Desert map changes[/B]
Champions don’t get stuck anymore after using a teleporter on a dessert map in certain conditions.

[h1]Abilities[/h1]

[B]Elemental alignment[/B] 
Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented abilities, that would change a unit’s magical element, to be applied.

[h1]Technical[/h1]

[B]Ironman loading [/B]
Using “Quick Load” in Ironman mode does not load non-Ironman saves anymore.

[B]Main menu background [/B]
The Northland main menu background shows up now.

[B]Game freeze[/B]
A rare issue that made loading a save game sometimes return an error that would freeze the game logic has been fixed.

[h1]Uplay[/h1]

[B]Language fix[/B]
The Uplay stats show up in the Spanish localization now.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1 (September 19th 2016)
notes.content:
[img]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/forums/headers_banners/banner_patchnotes_en.png[/img]

[h1]Missions & Adventures[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Action queue[/b] 
Fixed an issue with champions losing their action queue when being blocked by another unit.

[*][b]Spy Extraction missions[/b] 
Fixed enemies spawn in Spy Extraction missions. Now enemies stop spawning when the spy reaches the exit point.

[*][b]Fortification missions[/b] 
Fixed a possible crash in “Fortification” missions after loading a previously saved game.

[*][b]Unit animation[/b]
Fixed Spy unit being in T-pose during mission intro cinematic.

[*][b]Vargus[/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Vargus’ abilities would all be stuck on 20 seconds cooldown under certain conditions.
[*]Fixed missing wait time on charge fade out animation for Vargus.[/list]

[*][b]Ability casting[/b] 
Fixed chain abilities using wrong ability range radius.

[*][b]Fights[/b] 
Fixed issue where certain line attacks of champions were not hitting all enemies in the line.

[*][b]Stuck characters[/b]
Fixed a couple of issues with Champions and enemies getting stuck sometimes.

[*][b]Spawn point[/b]
Fixed allied NPC ghosts spawning in non-walkable sector on one of the Greenland maps.

[*][b]Teleporting[/b] 
Fixed Champions getting stuck after teleporting on of the Desert maps.

[*][b]Goliath pathfinding[/b] 
Fixed an issue where the Goliath unit was going under a bridge if the path is blocked on certain maps.[/list]

[h1]Worldmap[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Randomization improvements[/b] 
Adjusted the algorithm to ensure that missions played in adjacent territories will have different objectives.[/list]

[h1]Village[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Tutorial[/b]
Fixed Tutorial issue when players could remove buildings in the village using the "DEL" key.

[*][b]Toolmaker (NPC)[/b]
Fixed issue with Toolmaker NPC that was carrying an invisible log in the village.[/list]

[h1]Technical[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Black screen[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Intro Screen:[/b] The image was incorrectly scaled after a hardware exchange, which caused a black screen during the intro screen.
[*][b]Secondary monitor:[/b] Changing the game resolution to full screen mode could cause a black screen on the second monitor.[/list]

[*][b]Game Launch[/b]
Fixed a crash on launch caused by wrong graphics buffer initialization.

[*][b]Audio options[/b]
Fixed an error where the voice over option was defaulting to German.

[*][b]Options menu[/b]
Fixed "Cancel" functionality to return the value to the previous value.

[*][b]Cinematics[/b]
Fixed Tooltip on cursor being stuck in cinematics

[*][b]Flickering[/b]
Fixed rare cases of Particle flickering.

[*][b]Overlays[/b]
Fixed game interfering with Steam/Uplay overlay.

[*][b]Sound[/b]
Fixed rare case of game sound being played even after the game has been closed.

[*][b]Monitors[/b]
Fixed the recognition of certain monitor resolutions.[/list]

notes.title: Preview of the upcoming patch in September
notes.content:
Dear Champions!

The next patch will be released in September. The team is working on several improvements and fixes for the released game and the demo. We will give you the exact release date of the patch and the full patchnotes as soon as possible.  

We want to give you some first information about what is planned to be included in the patch (the team is working on more topics). Please continue to provide your feedback: The support and community team always forwards your opinions to the developers.

[IMG]http://static.cdn.ubi.com/0038/forums/headers_banners/banner_patchnotes_preview_en.png[/IMG]


[h1][B]Missions & Adventures[/B][/h1]
[LIST]
[*] [B]Pathfinding[/B] - Improved AI pathfinding in narrow corridors.[LIST]
[*] Allies will now wait and not run around the map to reach an unreachable enemy.
[*] Enemies will now attack a different target within range if they can’t reach their highest agro target.[/LIST] [/list]
[list]
[*] [B]Action queue[/B]
Fixed an issue with champions losing their action queue when being blocked by another unit.[/list]
[list]
[*] [B]Spy Extraction missions[/B]
Now enemies stop spawning when the spy reaches the exit point.[/list]
[list]
[*] [B]Fortification missions[/B]
Fixed a possible crash in “Fortification” missions after loading a previously saved game.[/list]
[list]
[*] [B]Teleporting[/B]
Fixed Champions getting stuck after teleporting on the Desert maps.[/list]
[list]
[*] [B]Goliath pathfinding[/B]
Fixed an issue where the Goliath unit was going under a bridge if the path is blocked on certain maps.
[/LIST]
[h1][B]World Map[/B][/h1]
[LIST]
[*] [B]Randomization improvements[/B]
Improved the algorithm that is choosing the mission type. In the future, randomized repetitions of obectives in neighboring territories are kept to a minimum.
[/LIST]
[h1][B]Technical Topics[/B][/h1]
[LIST]
[*] [B]Black screen[/B] [list]
[*][B]Intro Screen:[/B] The image was incorrectly scaled after a hardware exchange, which caused a black screen during the intro screen.
[*][B]Secondary monitor:[/B] Changing the game resolution to full screen mode could cause a black screen on the second monitor.[/list] [/list]
[list]
[*] [B]Game Launch[/B]
Fixed a crash on launch caused by wrong graphics buffer initialization.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [B]Flickering[/B]
Fixed rare cases of Particle flickering.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [B]Monitors[/B]
Fixed the recognition of certain monitor resolutions.
[/LIST]
Your CoA Team
